subject: planner: complete the memo/group-expression/group logic and add test for derive stats (#57973)
summary: Reviewed ba55be5 vs first parent, limited to planner/cascades memo infra and the new derive-stats casetest. Key behavior changes: Memo.CopyIn now supports mixed trees with existing *memo.GroupExpression children (for XForm re-feeding) and derives per-Group logical properties (schema+stats) bottom-up via GroupExpression.DeriveLogicalProp; Group exposes logical-prop/explored helpers; property.NewLogicalProp added; new casetest asserts memo groups retain schema/stats after core stats derivation. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/concurrency/privilege/session behavior within this change.
